method: src/engine/timeline/signals.null.test.ts: 45-day simulated diaries, 15% of days unanswered, a medicine started 16 days ago, no real effect. Independent: every day drawn afresh. Clustered: each item repeats yesterday's answer with probability `stay`, otherwise it is drawn from the same base rate (same long-run rates). Rates are the share of simulated changes with at least one moderate-or-strong signal (moderateRate), at least one strong signal (strongRate), or any weak-or-stronger difference, from Fisher's exact / Mann-Whitney alone. `gated` = the same simulated changes when a strength must also clear its p bar (strong 0.01, moderate 0.05) in the runs check, a seeded circular block-permutation test (src/engine/timeline/blockPermutation.ts) with blocks of runsCheck.blockDays days and runsCheck.B shuffles per comparison (the app uses runsCheck.appPermutations). runsCheck.gate says whether the app applies the gate (false = computed and reported, strengths unchanged). `power` = the same simulation with a real change (dizziness on 15% of days before the start, 45% from the start day on): the share of simulated changes where dizziness is flagged as worse. Each row uses n = 1,000 simulated changes, so it is noisier than the 8,000-change figures in the test header (e.g. independent strongRate 0.003 = 3 of 1,000 vs about 0.8% with 8,000). stay values are assumed levels of clustering, not measured from real diaries.
